prompt: Add a T3 enforcement block to this rule in .claude/rules/visual-rules.md: 'Empty states show a helpful illustration, not just text'. I've already decided it's T3 visual-qa — just generate the block. Also add blocks to the other two rules in the file: 'Page transitions are smooth and do not flash white' and 'Cards in a grid maintain equal gutters at every breakpoint'.
assertions: The empty-state instruction contains all 3 parts: what to look for (zero-data screens), violation (text only, no illustration), correct (illustration alongside text)
The transition instruction specifies what to look for (route navigation), what's wrong (white flash, abrupt change), what's right (smooth transition)
The gutter instruction specifies breakpoints, what's wrong (unequal gaps), what's right (consistent spacing)
No instruction is a vague one-liner like 'Check that X looks good'
Each instruction is specific enough that a visual-qa agent could deterministically judge pass/fail
All three blocks have appropriate scope, group, and priority fields
